name: FLIGHT 404 Blender cabin
authorship: Original project-authored Blender geometry; no external model or texture sources.
notes: 31.45m cabin with 4m aft vestibule, 20 linked-source seats, recessed transparent windows and open cockpit windscreen.
Original catering cart, crew storage, lavatory facade, luggage, folded jumpseat and extinguisher; amenities respect server colliders.
All task stations and collision logic remain separate.
cabin_emissive can be dimmed at runtime for blackout.
Textures are embedded PNGs; glTF uses standard PBR materials.
